headline: Texans Activate RT Braden Smith From IR

headline: Source: Lamar Jackson has realistic chance to play Ravens' Week 6 game at Browns
summary: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson has a realistic chance to return for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns, a league source told ESPN.

headline: NFL Hands Rams LT Alaric Jackson Two-Game Suspension
summary: Rams left tackle Alaric Jackson punched Bills outside linebacker Bradley Chubb after Buffalo defeated Los Angeles on Monday night. The NFL reviewed the incident and has decided to suspend Jackson two games without pay, Aaron Wilson of KPRC2 reports. The league has since announced the ban. headline: Tyreek Hill found liable for 2 of 10 counts in battery trial; wife awarded $500K
summary: A Miami jury returned a mixed verdict in the assault and battery civil trial against Tyreek Hill, finding the former NFL receiver liable for two counts of battery but not liable for the eight other claims made by his estranged wife, Lakeeta Vaccaro.
